dataset.name: real WANDS catalog, 7 real depth-1 category checkpoints (n=2,002 to n=16,039) plus whole-catalog numeric range (n=31,967) -- identical to P6E-E00

engine_config.opensearch: 2.17.0, embedded single-node via org.opensearch.test:framework's OpenSearchSingleNodeTestCase, run as non-root user
engine_config.solr: Apache Solr 9.10.1, wands_bench core; live in-process cross-check blocked (see named_limitation); indirect corroboration via P6E-E00's own already-verified counts

headline_result.embedded_node_bootstrap: a real single-node OpenSearch 2.17.0 cluster starts and serves requests in-process, after fixing 4 concrete disclosed blockers distinct from P6E-E00's four (missing log4j-core, OpenSearch's own bootstrap hard-refusing to run as root -- unlike ES's equivalent check which only warned --, wrong pre-8.x xcontent package paths, missing decRef() method)
headline_result.unfixed_blocker: running as the non-root user required to fix the root-refusal also activates OpenSearch's SecurityManager network restrictions, denying the live Solr HTTP cross-check -- disclosed as unresolved, not worked around
headline_result.correctness_evidence: indirect: every candidate count OpenSearch reported (2002/2175/2072/3394/4612/4686/16039/31967) across all 3 runs matches digit-for-digit the Solr-verified ground truth P6E-E00's own live check already established for the identical checkpoints -- weaker evidence than a live in-process check
headline_result.timing_result: color_facet_under_category: OpenSearch 1.2x-2.25x SLOWER than Solr's own facet.field at every one of 7 checkpoints tested, comparable to Elasticsearch's own 1.2x-2.0x range (P6E-E00) -- same qualitative finding reproduces on the other major Lucene-based engine
headline_result.named_limitation: OpenSearch and Elasticsearch not measured in the same process/session; no live Solr correctness check for OpenSearch in this pass; only single-node/single-shard OpenSearch tested; mechanism inferred not profiled
